description: SGLang fork serving natlang's LFM3 RL actors (owner decision 2026-10-29: upstream-maintained Liquid LFM3 implementation, sgl-project/sglang PR #46858, for dependability). The PR branch (with the upstream main it contains) plus natlang commits: exact post-temperature sampled-token logprob and top-k returned compactly per token (custom_params.natlang_top_k); LFM3 producer spans (the export's producing embedding table, span state mapped in extend and decode) and the native-state export of a closed span (custom_params.natlang_capture) and native-state import through content-hashed placeholders (custom_params.natlang_import), and per-request native adapters in resident low-rank slots (custom_params.natlang_adapter; batches without an adapted request replay the base-only decode graph). The natlang serving front is serve/sglang_actor.py (scripts/neuralese_data/serve_native_checkpoint.py --engine sglang); the checkpoint is served through export/native_hf.py. NATLANG_FORK.md in the fork documents the base, our commits and the rebase procedure. A separate git checkout, not vendored.
install: uv venv -p 3.12 VENV && uv pip install -p VENV/bin/python -e ../sglang-natlang/python --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu130 --index-strategy unsafe-best-match
parity: scripts/neuralese_data/check_sglang_lfm3_parity.py (LFM3 logits: chunked prefill and cached decode against the vendored HF reference)
scripts/neuralese_data/check_sglang_producer_parity.py (producer spans and span export against native_step: perturbed adapter, forced and decoded spans, BF16 noise floor)
scripts/neuralese_data/check_sglang_adapter_parity.py (native adapter stacks through resident slots against run_native)
scripts/neuralese_data/check_sglang_hybrid_swa.py (hybrid SWA KV against the previous fork commit: greedy, prefix hits, Neuralese imports, retract/update_weights; `pair` runs both)

previous_commit.note: Prior fork head (intake validation of natlang custom_params), full-length KV in all 11 LFM3 attention layers. The engine of every experiment running on 2026-11-13 (grpo-v1-run2, grpo-v2-run1, held-v2 series): the checkout /home/werg/sglang-natlang (and Pop's) stays here until the next experiment boundary.

qualification: The explicit FFN-only execution profile and SGLang dispatch have CPU coverage only. Native and SGLang whole-model state, actor/learner replay, held behavior and performance remain unqualified.
bf16_reduction: NATLANG_BF16_REDUCTION defaults to fp32-accumulate; reduced is historical replay only
projection: NATLANG_SGLANG_PROJECTION (serve_native_checkpoint.py --sglang-projection): native = the learner's invariant native_step projection kernel; vendor = one fused vendor BF16 GEMM per projection with fp32 accumulation, an actor law the learner recomputes and corrects with importance weights under the engine-mismatch guard (rl/native_replay.py).
top_k_mass: custom_params.natlang_top_k_mass: records end with the exact FP32 tail mass (review F6); the natlang front already sends and reads it. Merged into the fork branch natlang and pushed 2026-11-09. The declared commit is advisory: the actor attestation records the fork checkout's actual commit.
hybrid_swa_kv: ace8d6868 (2026-11-13): LFM3's 5 sliding layers keep only their 256-token window in SGLang's SWA pool, the 6 full layers every token (KV 11 -> 6 layers + 0.1 x 5 in the SWA pool; 16 GB FP8 holds 2.40M instead of 1.42M tokens). The front sizes the pool from the fork's NATLANG_HYBRID_SWA_KV marker (serve_native_checkpoint.py --sglang-swa-ratio 0.1; --sglang-full-kv opts out) and attests serving_engine.kv_layout. Engine identity changes with the fork commit: held results pair only within one fork commit, so the start policy is re-measured on it. NOT adopted by running experiments: enters at the next experiment boundary (ops/decisions.log 2026-11-13). Parity: scripts/neuralese_data/check_sglang_hybrid_swa.py (FP8 run against 70b1991e6: deterministic sections bitwise identical; the BF16-KV pair remains to run at a boundary gap).
track_input_end: 33230160b (2026-11-14, branch natlang, child of ace8d6868 = natlang head): custom_params.natlang_track_input_end makes the scheduler cut a request's prefill so its last extend is a whole number of 256-token grids, so the extra_buffer conv state lands exactly on the input end (PrefillAdder._natlang_input_end_extend); no forward, kernel or CUDA-graph change. The front reads the NATLANG_TRACK_INPUT_END marker (attest_sglang_source) and sets it on the request that warms a decision's shared opening (sglang_actor._sglang_warm_opening): every input then prefills only its own messages; on older forks the state stays up to 255 tokens short. CPU unit tests only (fork test/natlang/test_track_input_end.py); NOT adopted by running experiments, whose engine.json pins stay: it is the pin of the next experiment, which also adopts ace8d6868's hybrid SWA KV. Fast-forwarded into branch natlang 2026-11-14 (the branch natlang-track-input-end is gone); running experiments are unaffected because they pin commits.
